name: Shrine of the Fallen Warrior
summary: At the Shrine of the Fallen Warrior, Koiter watches over an orc laid to rest on a ridge west of the Crossroads. A stone plinth marked 'MK' keeps the warrior's memory beneath the Barrens sky.

sections.title: A Silent Vigil
sections.body:
High on the hills northwest of the Crossroads, the shrine offers a quiet place amid the Barrens' dust and peril. Find the ridge southwest of the summit and follow its winding path to a gentle mound. A carved stone monument rests at the top, its plinth marked with the initials 'MK'.

An armored orc warrior lies before it, watched day and night by Koiter, a Spirit Healer. No battle horns sound here. The shrine honors a champion who walked Kalimdor's lands.

sections.title: The Meaning of the Memorial
sections.body:
The shrine honors a departed champion of the Horde. The warrior's soul lingers in the spirits' care, beneath the watch of Koiter.

The monument also remembers Michel Koiter, an illustrator who died while the world was being made. The resting warrior was modeled on Koiter's own early character, Twincruiser, and his memory remains beneath Kalimdor's open skies.

faq.q: Where is the Shrine of the Fallen Warrior located?
aliases: how to get to shrine of fallen warrior
faq.answer: The shrine stands atop a hill west of the Crossroads in the northern Barrens. Find the ridge southwest of the high ground and follow its winding path to the grassy knoll.

faq.q: Who is the orc lying upon the plinth?
faq.answer: The orc represents a revered fallen warrior. His form was modeled on Twincruiser, an orc warrior played during the world's early development by artist Michel Koiter, who has since died.

faq.q: What does the 'MK' carved into the stone mean?
faq.answer: The initials 'MK' honor Michel Koiter, a senior artist who died in 2004 while the world was being made.

faq.q: Who is the Spirit Healer standing beside the shrine?
faq.answer: The Spirit Healer is named Koiter. Unlike ordinary Spirit Healers, who appear only to spirits walking in death, Koiter keeps vigil where living travelers can see him.

faq.q: Are there any quests associated with this shrine?
faq.answer: No. The Shrine of the Fallen Warrior is not tied to any task or faction conflict. It remains a quiet place of reflection and remembrance.

angles.text: As a warrior, you may come to this hill to honor a fallen brother in arms, who fought bravely before passing into legend.
As a member of the Horde, you find this solitary resting place in Horde lands. It recalls the honor, duty and sacrifice held in Kalimdor's shamanic and warrior traditions.
